title: Longest Common Prefix
statement:
Find the longest string that every word in a list starts with.

Contract
- `words` is non-null and may be empty. Every element is non-null and contains
  only the lowercase letters `a` through `z`. A word may be empty.
- Return the longest string that is a prefix of every word. Return `""` when
  the words share no first letter, when any word is empty, or when `words` is
  empty.
- A single word is its own longest common prefix.
- Do not mutate the array.

Examples
- `longestCommonPrefix(new String[]{"flower", "flow", "flight"})` returns `"fl"`.
- `longestCommonPrefix(new String[]{"dog", "racecar", "car"})` returns `""`.
- `longestCommonPrefix(new String[]{"interview"})` returns `"interview"`.
hints: The answer can never be longer than the shortest word.
Compare column by column: check the character at position i in every word before moving on to position i + 1.

Stop at the first position where some word ends or disagrees with the first word, and return the first word's prefix up to that position. Intended complexity: O(n) time over the n total characters and O(1) extra space beyond the returned prefix.
inputSyntax: Input: the words in brackets, for example: [flower, flow, flight]
